about: fk-board's application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk11-key-not-between
mutants.rule: A key made between two keys is strictly between them (law BetweenIsStrictlyBetween).

mutants.name: fk11-insert-key-ignores-next
mutants.from: let hi Option[string] = if i == len(c.Cards) { None } else { Some[string]{Value: c.Cards[i].Key} }
mutants.rule: A card's key is below the next card's, so keys keep the column's order (law SortKeysStrictlyIncrease).

mutants.name: fk11-past-the-end-lands-on-top
mutants.from: } else if at > len(c.Cards) { len(c.Cards) } else
mutants.rule: A position past the end of a column is its end (law ReorderIsAPermutation).

mutants.name: fk11-move-to-no-column-drops-the-card
mutants.rule: A reorder to a column the board does not have changes nothing (law ReorderIsAPermutation).

mutants.name: fk11-step-counts-the-lifted-card
mutants.rule: A keyboard step down stops at the column's end, counted without the lifted card (case tour).

mutants.name: fk11-next-past-the-last-column
mutants.rule: A move to the next column stops at the last column (case tour).

mutants.name: fk11-threshold-inclusive
mutants.rule: A move of exactly the threshold starts a drag (law DragStartsPastTheThreshold).

mutants.name: fk11-release-over-nothing-silent
mutants.rule: A release over nothing cancels the drag, and a screen reader says so (case tour).

mutants.name: fk11-keyboard-cancel-keeps-focus
mutants.rule: Escape in a keyboard drag focuses the card again (case tour).

mutants.name: fk11-blank-title-added
mutants.rule: A blank title adds no card (law NewCardFollowsTheForm).

mutants.name: fk11-form-stays-open
mutants.rule: Adding a card shuts the form (law NewCardFollowsTheForm).

mutants.name: fk11-drop-not-saved
mutants.rule: A drop saves the board once (law KeyboardDropEqualsPointerDrop).

mutants.name: fk11-cancel-forgets-the-card
mutants.rule: A cancel says which card went back, read from the drag before it (case tour).

mutants.name: fk11-column-move-said-as-position
mutants.rule: A keyboard move to another column says the column (case tour).

mutants.name: fk11-file-line-uncounted
mutants.rule: A foreign line in the board file is named by its number (law AForeignLineIsNamed).

mutants.name: fk11-file-drops-description
mutants.rule: The file keeps every text of a card (law board.Store.LoadGivesTheLastSave for Sheet).

mutants.name: fk11-shelf-forgets
mutants.rule: A load gives the last save (law board.Store.LoadGivesTheLastSave for Shelf).
